backend_matrix.reason: Canonical v2 thin-layer torque has an independent CPU double algebraic oracle; canonical prescribed SOT has bounded FEM CPU and non-tabulated stage-time FEM GPU reference realizations, including a managed CPU Heun rollback retry at the same pulse knot. Full trajectory, GPU/all-integrator rollback, multi-grid, and continuum qualification remain open.

Managed CUDA Slonczewski one-step, bounded eight-step FP64 CPU↔GPU Heun trajectory, target-mask/current-reversal, isolated 0.5x/1x/2x tangential current-scaling, constant-envelope prescribed-SOT one-step, and sinusoidal stage-time prescribed-SOT Heun SI-oracle contracts pass. GPU event-aware rollback, full integrator-family, tabulated artifacts, multi-grid, and cross-backend qualification remain open; rollback is bounded only on the FEM CPU Heun lane.

Canonical signed-current reference lane, independent eight-step fixed-step trajectory oracle, and bounded isolated 0.5x/1x/2x current-increment scaling contract exist; nonlinear current-sweep and cross-backend qualification remain open.

Managed CUDA FP64 parity passes for the Slonczewski one-step/eight-step trajectories plus bounded isolated 0.5x/1x/2x current scaling, and canonical prescribed-SOT has a separate bounded eight-step/scaling contract; FEM GPU adds constant and sinusoidal stage-time one-step SI-oracle contracts. FP32 envelopes, event alignment, tabulated artifacts, nonlinear current sweeps, cross-backend parity, and full qualification remain open.
